Setting up Coop

✓ Coop project created
  Codex has instructions, skills, and one task queue.
  Formatting checked before every commit: go

Network access is filtered.
Codex can reach OpenAI.
Other network traffic is blocked until you approve rules allowing it.

Build the box
  Review .agent/Dockerfile, then run:
  → coop build

Verify the sandbox
  → coop doctor

Start working
  → coop tasks add "Describe your first task"
  → coop loop codex
